Jal Nigam, Uttar Pradesh
Office of the Executive Engineer · Uttar Pradesh · IN
No. CC/58/2018/130
Dated: 31 Mar 2026
Certificate of Completion of Work
This is to certify that the work of “Extradosed Bridge — Uttar Pradesh Pkg-130” (large bridges), awarded
to M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has been
completed in all respects on 18 May 2018 at a gross executed value of INR 41.45 Cr (Rupees 41.45 Crore
Only).
The agency attended to all observations raised during execution and the work was taken over on satisfactory
completion of the final inspection.
The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Farhan Roy. This certificate is issued for record and for
submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past performance.
Executive Engineer
Jal Nigam, Uttar Pradesh
